## What's changed

- Fixed Local Media automation so paired-player heartbeat updates no longer restart real-time monitoring or trigger repeated incremental library scans.
- Kept automatic scans responsive to genuine Local Media, FFmpeg path, and metadata storage changes.
- Interleaved auto-generated Tube TV movie and series channels while preserving custom channel numbers and the established order within each channel type.
- Refreshed the Tube TV guide cache format so the new channel order appears immediately after updating.
